packageRules.description: Update all OpenTelemetry Go modules in one pull request, because they depend on each other.
Group Docker digest-only updates into one weekly pull request.
A person reviews each major update. The auto-merge workflow refuses a pull request with this label.

Node and pnpm install and build the web workspace, and pnpm applies its supply-chain controls. Wait 3 days, as for npm. The Node image also waits, so that the node group updates mise.toml and the image together.
Update the Go of mise.toml and the Go images in one pull request, so that the versions agree (mise run lint:versions).
Update the Node of mise.toml and the Node image in one pull request, so that the versions agree (mise run lint:versions).
Update the bjw-s common library chart of each chart in one pull request, so that the charts have the same library behaviour.

The auto-merge workflow cannot merge a pull request that changes workflow files when main also changed workflow files after its base. Rebase these pull requests when main moves, so that the workflow can merge them.
